Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG + SOC 2 evidence intake we need detailed artifacts related to encryption key management for the tenant we will onboard (Finexa-prod). Specifically we need: 

- TTLs and retention for plaintext-encrypting keys and wrapped key material (what is kept at rest and for how long).
- Rotation logs for all customer KEKs/KMS operations for the last 12 months (including operator IDs, rotation commit/event IDs, and timestamps).
- HSM attestation / firmware baseline for the HSM cluster used for root wrapping (vendor, model, attestation report version).
- Evidence of cross-region key replication: how keys are wrapped in transit and whether replicated keys retain the same KEK lineage.
- A short writeup of how you validate wipeproofs/ephemeral key eviction after tenant deprovisioning and a sample sanitized log showing key eviction events.

Deliverables: compressed rotation log CSVs or a filtered JSON export, an HSM attestation PDF, diagram of cross-region replication, and your current key retention policy doc. Can you confirm what you can provide and a target date? We can accept secure Drive upload or SFTP to our intake bucket (we prefer encrypted Drive).

We may redact operator usernames but we need stable IDs and timestamps preserved. Also please include any mapping to SOC 2 control IDs or SIG questions if available.

Thanks,
Alice Moreno
Senior InfoSec Manager — Finexa
security@finexa.com

Alice — attaching the initial package to the secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINEXA-secure-share (access granted to security@finexa.com, expires 2029-06-05). Brief contents below: 

Attachments (in folder and zipped):
- kms-rotation-log-202904.zip — contains `rotation-2028-05_to_2029-04.csv` (columns: event_id, utc_timestamp, operation, key_token, region, operator_pseudo) and `rotation-to-sig-mapping.csv` (mapping to SIG-KM-IDs). All keys are tokenized; no plaintext key material included.
- hsm-audit-summary-2029Q1.pdf — vendor-signed attestation (reference: HSM-VendorX v5.2, attestation id A-2029Q1-17).
- cross-region-replication-diagram.png — diagram showing wrapping/unwrapping flow and KEK lineage labels.
- retention-policy-v2.md — full retention policy excerpt showing TTLs: customer-wrapped-kept: 90 days, intermediate-wrapping-keys: 365 days, root-wrapping-keys (HSM-only metadata): retained until rotation + 30 days for audit (rotation cadence 12 months).

Key notes / answers to your bullets: 
- Rotation cadence: automatic KEK rotation every 12 months by default; short-lived ephemeral wrapping keys for session tokens rotate per deployment (minutes-hours).
- Cross-region replication: replicated keys use envelope encryption; the root KEK remains HSM-protected per-region and we maintain a KEK lineage record so replicated entries reference a parent event_id. Replication events include `source_event_id` and `replication_event_id` in the CSV.
- Wipeproof / deprovision: eviction is an orchestrated workflow that calls a multi-step wipe. Sample sanitized events are included in the CSV (search for operation=evict). We log confirmation events with immutable event_ids and they are retained per retention policy above.
- HSM details: VendorX HSM cluster, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, firmware v5.2. Attestation report included; operator access enforced via role separation and time-limited bastion sessions.

If you want additional raw indexes (we can provide a filtered S3 export under an NDA), let us know. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the artifacts — propose 2029-05-24 10am PT if that works.

Thanks,
